calculation.expression: negative 5-day residual return after cross-asset beta regression to equal-weight universe
calculation.description: Ranks assets by reversal in the component of recent five-day return unexplained by their rolling market beta exposure, using only lagged prices.

validation.regime_notes: Positive annual IC in every reported year from 2020 through 2026, with lower 2026 IC. Correlation audit reported 1.0 against a same-signal artifact; deterministic gate should recompute and deduplicate provenance before admission.
